### 2026-10-18 – Lapsed the entire project over multiple sessions.

**11.53h**

Lapsed the entire project over multiple sessions.

I first built three marble paths/ runs - after figuring out how to use the different kinds of planes on Onshape. I added a lot of supports (I've had experience with 3d printed designs falling without them!) and also this wavy track and a plinko track - where the marbles are eventually collected.

Among stuff that didn't work - it took a me a long time to figure out how to make curved (continuous) marble paths - as they would bend weirdly when I changed the plane orientation. I also had trouble with paths turning upside down - I later figured out that I had to edit the path profile/ sweep profile for each new plane to avoid that. I also made the neck of some parts (of the run) 7mm long for an 8mm marble to fix this problem.

I've made all the supports separate printable parts - which I can insert into the base during assembly. All the marble runs are also separate printable parts, which I plan to fix onto the supports :).
